tasks.title: SiK RSSI in dBm
tasks.statement: A SiK modem reports RSSI = **{r}**. Convert it to dBm (approximately dBm ≈ RSSI/1.9 − 127).

tasks.title: Fade margin
tasks.statement: `RADIO_STATUS`: rssi = **{r}**, noise = **{n}** (SiK units, one unit ≈ 0.5 dB). Find the fade margin (dB).
tasks.solution: Margin ≈ (RSSI − noise) / 2 dB: one SiK RSSI unit ≈ 0.5 dB.

tasks.title: Margin and range
tasks.statement: At the test distance the fade margin is **{m} dB**. How many times farther can you go if you keep **{k} dB** in reserve (every 6 dB doubles the range)?
tasks.solution: Usable margin is m − k; range × 2^((m − k)/6).
